Decree n°2026-0097/PT-RM, published in the Journal Officiel of 6 March 2026, approves the National Cybersecurity Strategy (SNCS) and its 2026-2030 action plan; the decree's own date is not in the passages, so the gazette date is used.

facts.fact: The CNT ratified on 2026-11-19 Ordinance No. 2026-031/PT-RM of 25 September 2026 creating Mali's national information-systems security agency (ANSSI), charged with protecting critical digital infrastructure and coordinating the response to cyberattacks.
The article says a national cybersecurity strategy and its 2026-2030 action plan were adopted by decree on 25 February.
